The Weather Company® is here to help you plan each day, from knowing when to toss a sweater in your bag to when your plane might experience turbulence en route. We know that your Personal Data (defined in section “Personal Data”) is important to you. It’s important to us too! We believe in ethical and transparent use of Personal Data.

We have designed this Privacy Policy focused on how you interact with our Services (defined in section “We Are The Weather Company”) and common questions you may have. Our Privacy Policy applies differently depending on how you use our Services and where you’re located. Check section “Global Disclosures” for region-specific information (for example, California, European Union/European Economic Area/United Kingdom, and South Korea), and if you're here for business rather than our consumer weather products, head to section “Data Collection Outside Our Consumer Weather Products.”

Our goal is to be clear and transparent. If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please ask us (see section “Support & Feedback (How to Contact Us)”).

We are The Weather Company, LLC, including our subsidiaries and affiliates (“we,” “us,” and “our”) and the online services that bring weather information to you. These collective services (“Services”) include:

  • The Weather Channel® (weather.com website, mobile apps, in-vehicle app, app for Apple TV, and skill for Amazon Alexa);
  • Weather Underground® (wunderground.com website and mobile apps);
  • Storm Radar™ (mobile app);
  • SnowCast™ (mobile app); and
  • Any other websites and services that reference or link to this Privacy Policy.

The Services do not include websites, apps, or other services that reference, link to, or are subject to another privacy policy. In particular, this Privacy Policy does not apply to The Weather Channel TV App, The Weather Channel Television Network, and any related websites or other online properties provided by Weather Group Television, LLC or any other Allen Media Group affiliated entities.

This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, process, and share Personal Data as a data controller. Please also read our Terms of Use, which set out the terms governing the Services.

The numbered sections below are intended to help you more easily understand how we process Personal Data when you interact with and connect with us about our consumer weather products.

There may be some additional global disclosures that apply to our processing of Personal Data and your privacy rights. Where applicable and necessary, we have outlined those in the numbered sections below.
